initial_pose: published default-pose keyframe followed by 20000 passive 0.0001-activation MuJoCo steps
position_reference: left-front knee q at the common keyframe-derived passive initial state
sensor_drive_rule: gain * max(0, polarity * (q_start - q_reference)); blocked case uses zero
purpose: Exploratory full-CNS proprioceptive polarity comparison from a source-keyframe-derived FlyMimic pose; no per-cell polarity or voltage gain has been measured.
